_notes: A tiny test chapter for the game frame (Milestone 6 part A). Not part of the story.
start: where a new game begins. 'opening' is a conversation played on black before the first picture.

phases: the times of day. power = lights in group 'mains' are on. candles = lights in group 'candles' are on. snow = heavy / light / none (outside maps only). instant = the change cuts instead of fading.
beats: the story, in order. A beat is done when 'complete_when' passes; then 'on_complete' runs, in order.
lead: shown in the pause menu only. auto_play: a conversation that starts by itself on that map, once.
debug_grant: what a player who reached this beat would hold, and where they would stand (F9 beat jumper, debug builds only).
board: the case board file this chapter uses.
start.opening may be a conversation id, or a list of effects played on black before the first picture (here: Chapter 1's opening film).
auto_play may start a conversation ({"map", "conversation"}) or a cutscene ({"map", "cutscene"}).
